producer.name: AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.FixedSpectrumGridAlias.actual_midpoint_grid_cosine_alias
producer.signature:
theorem actual_midpoint_grid_cosine_alias {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) (k : ℤ) :
  let θ : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  (∑ i : Fin d, Real.cos ((k : ℝ) * θ i)) =
    (d : ℝ) * (if (2 * (d : ℤ)) ∣ k then
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ (k / (2 * (d : ℤ))) else 0)
outputs: Exact midpoint cosine sum for every integer frequency, including zero and negative frequencies.

actual_private_consumer.name: actual_weighted_inverse_grid_alias_series
actual_private_consumer.signature:
private theorem actual_weighted_inverse_grid_alias_series {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d)
    {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 2 ≤ κ) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hnd : n < d) :
  let θ : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  let eigenvalue : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => (κ + 1) / 2 + (κ - 1) / 2 * Real.cos (θ i)
  let r : ℝ := (Real.sqrt κ - 1) / (Real.sqrt κ + 1)
  let a : ℤ → ℝ := fun k =>
    if (2 * (d : ℤ)) ∣ k then (-1 : ℝ) ^ (k / (2 * (d : ℤ))) else 0
  Summable (fun j : ℕ => (-r) ^ (j + 1) *
    (a (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - (n : ℤ)) +
      a (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + (n : ℤ)))) ∧
  (∑ i : Fin d, Real.cos ((n : ℝ) * θ i) / eigenvalue i) =
    ((d : ℝ) / Real.sqrt κ) * ∑' j : ℕ, (-r) ^ (j + 1) *
      (a (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - (n : ℤ)) +
        a (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + (n : ℤ)))

definition_audit.meaning: Fin d index i corresponds to source index i+1; (i.val+1/2)*pi/d equals (source_i-1/2)*pi/d. Finite sum is over all d points.

Real-valued piecewise coefficient. The true branch uses integer exponent (zpow) of -1 with integer quotient k/(2*d). With d>=2 the divisor is positive, and in the divisible branch this quotient is exactly the source integer a in k=2*a*d. Outside divisibility the coefficient is literally zero; quotient fallback has no mathematical effect.
All k:Int retained. k=0 has quotient0 and sum d. Negative aliases use negative integer powers of nonzero -1; no natural truncation or lost parity. Nonaliases remain zero.
Exactly the source half-shifted cosine eigenvalue grid and principal-real-square-root radius. Positivity of denominators and 0<r<1 are produced internally, not binders.
j:Nat means source positive frequency j+1; j+1-n is formed in Int and may be negative. No Nat subtraction/truncation is permitted.
Standard real infinite sum. Actual supported series summability is produced in the conclusion, so the identity cannot gain meaning solely from a nonsummable default value.
Unnormalized sum of cos(n theta_i)/lambda_i. Gaussian expectation identification is not defined into the theorem, assumed as a binder or claimed proved.
